title: Check: a branch that drops ledger entries present on main fails
goal: check:gauntlet-runs (or a sibling) compares the branch ledger with origin/main and fails when an entry disappears without a superseding entry
acceptance: A failing-first test with a fixture ledger missing an entry
A newer entry for the same pack, case and profile is not a drop
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: 1.5 h agent. Implemented the same day: tools/check-gauntlet-ledger.mjs in check:fast and CI, its test committed first. Remaining: CI.
